name: agenthub
description: Lets your Claude Code sessions find teammates' agents on the same repo and exchange reviews, questions and handoffs through Agent Hub.

auto_update.title: Keep the agenthub CLI up to date
auto_update.description: Run agenthub update in the background when a session starts and a newer release is out.

wake_when_idle.title: Wake idle sessions for hub messages
wake_when_idle.description: When a teammate's agent sends this session a request while it waits for you, start a turn so it can answer or review (read-only) right away. fyi broadcasts never wake it.
